section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: In a small rural school with only one teacher, students of Classes 1, 2, and 3 sit in the same room and are taught together, with the teacher using grouped activities, peer-help, and self-learning materials suited to each group's level simultaneously. This teaching situation and approach is called:
explanation: Multigrade teaching refers to a single teacher handling two or more grades simultaneously in one classroom, requiring group-based, self-learning, and peer-tutoring strategies.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: A school integrates lessons on honesty, respect for others, cooperation, and environmental responsibility into everyday teaching and school activities, aiming to shape students' character and moral conduct alongside academics. This aspect of schooling is called:
explanation: Value education aims to develop ethical, moral, and social values in students, typically woven into the curriculum and school culture.
